source.note: Same kit and recipe as mini-male-b and mini-female-b (FBX member with its colour map, all 32 clips with their Kenney names, height 1.1 m: Kenney minis are chibi, the head is about 40 % of the body, so a real adult scale would make the head huge; noon script, faceted shading). She is the grey-haired older woman of the kit, hair up in a bun with a headband, a pearl-bead necklace and a skirt; she holds nothing (no cane or crutch on her rig). Kenney paints her blue top, orange skirt and grey hair; within the noon script she is set apart from mini-female-a (red top, brown trousers), mini-female-b (white top, red trousers), mini-male-a (red top, brown trousers) and mini-male-b (sand top, black trousers) by a brown top over a red skirt, silver (cream) hair with a red headband, a dark belt and white beads. ingest.maxColors is 24 so the shoe soles split from the skin swatch (dark soles); the shoe uppers share Kenney's skin swatch and stay skin-toned, and her tights share the hair swatch, so they read as pale stockings. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0. Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane by her own probed depths (soles lowest: sit 0.134 m, drive 0.129 m, wheelchair-sit and wheelchair-look 0.133 m; set their lift to 0 to seat her on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height). Her arm stubs stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed. The sprint and die clips are authored with real air time.
